footer.questions: A question? Just reply to this email.

order.subject: Order #{number} confirmed
order.preview: Thank you! We received the payment for order #{number}.
order.title: Thank you for your order!
order.intro: we received your payment and your order is being processed. We will write when it ships.
order.nextText: We confirm the delivery date by email. If you ordered a unit we install, we will contact you to arrange a site visit.
order.withdrawalText: You may withdraw from the purchase within 14 days of receiving the goods, without giving a reason. The conditions are on the Returns and withdrawal page and in the Terms.

shipped.subject: Order #{number} has shipped
shipped.preview: Your order is on its way.
shipped.title: Your order is on its way
shipped.text: order #{number} has shipped. The courier will contact you about the delivery.
shipped.check: Check the parcel in front of the courier. If it is visibly damaged, note it in the courier's report and email us photos.

welcome.subject: Welcome to {brand}
welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.text: thank you for creating an account. You will find your orders, addresses and saved products in it.
welcome.help: Not sure what you need? Read our guides and calculators or write to us: we are glad to help.

confirm.subject: Confirm your email
confirm.preview: One more step to your account.
confirm.title: Confirm your email
confirm.text: to finish registering, confirm that this email is yours. The link is valid for 48 hours.
confirm.ignore: If you did not register, just ignore this email.

reset.subject: A new password for your account
reset.preview: A link to set a new password.
reset.title: New password
reset.text: We received a request for a new password for the account with this email. The link is valid for one hour.
reset.ignore: If you did not ask for a new password, ignore this email: your password stays as it is.

exists.subject: You already have an account
exists.preview: There is already an account with this email.
exists.title: You already have an account
exists.text: Someone (probably you) tried to create an account with this email, but one already exists. Sign in, or set a new password if you forgot the old one.
exists.ignore: If it was not you, there is nothing to do.
